name: Sandbox Agent
description: In-pod Rust supervisor the base images bake in via COPY --from. The base seeds pull it from the prebuilt public image (ghcr.io/frak-id/sandbox-agent, config sandbox.agentImage) by default, so building this seed is only needed to self-host/mirror the agent in an air-gapped cluster — then point sandbox.agentImage at your own registry. Source lives in apps/agent-v2 and is copied into this seed at server-build time (in dev it builds straight from apps/agent-v2).
